item.tib: sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i man ngag dang spyi rgyug gi 'dod gsol yid bzhin nor bu
item.coloph: zhes pa'i man ngag sku gsung thugs 'khor dang / spyir rgyug 'dod gsol yid bzhin nor bu 'di/ thos bsam bka' lung rgya mtsho'i gter gling nas/ lhag bsam nam mkha' lta bu'i rgya bskyed cing / bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzug phyir blangs pa yin/ rmongs pas khron dang rin chen ma nor zhig 'on kyang ma rtogs log pas rlung langs nas/ lam 'khyal phyogs su gyur na mkhyen pa can/ thar lam ded dpon rnams kyis thugs ma g.yel/ bdag gzhan 'dod pa'i don kun gnas de ru/ mi 'gyang myur po'i shul du tshud par mdzod//
